title: Studio 变更 drawer: on publish, offer 补默认值 per new field that carries a default, through the protocol's opt-in backfill (ruling A on cloud#2924)
body:
Blocked-by: #12971 (the `.objectstack-sha` move to an objectstack `main` commit carrying `1e001c7df` — re-pointed by the triage seat from objectstack-ai/objectstack#24168: objectui consumes `@objectstack/*` by commit since #12957, so this card waits on the pin, not on an npm release)

Filed by the director seat (summon #43 continuation 4, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) on the maintainer's ruling A on objectstack-ai/cloud#2924 (batch #362 item 1, 「其他同意」; the ruling record is that card's `Ruled:` line), under the maintainer's standing 口径 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台」: the protocol half is objectstack-ai/objectstack#24253 and lands first. ⛔ Not a claim. Filing gate ①: a ruled design element with a named consumer.

## What is measured
- The ruled StudioCopilot design (cloud#2924, the maintainer's 「同意」): a copilot change to a live app with records is saved as a Studio draft; the applied card says 「已有 N 条记录的 X 为空，发布时可选补 0」. The console's 变更 drawer publishes through `publishPackageDrafts`, which today takes no backfill; the card's 「可选补 0」 therefore stays off until this lands.

## Scope
1. In the 变更 drawer, each pending field addition that carries a `defaultValue` shows an unchecked 「补默认值（N 条已有记录）」 option; publishing passes the checked fields to the protocol's opt-in backfill and shows the per-field count the response returns.
2. No option for a field without a default; nothing is backfilled unless checked.
3. `Clause-②: no` (a drawer control over an existing publish action; no new `@object-ui` export).

## Done when
- A test: a draft adding a boolean with a default over N rows publishes with the option checked and the response count N is shown; unchecked, nothing is written.
- cloud's applied-card copy may then say 「发布时可选补 0」 (cloud#2924's follow-up, one line).

Related: objectstack-ai/cloud#2924, objectstack-ai/objectstack#24253, objectstack-ai/objectui#12894 (the card rendering half).
